comment: Gate judges (D-44, Q-3) chosen by the G1 v2 calibration 2026-11-09 (report 04b): two vendors judge, a third-vendor model arbitrates G1 disputes. Fact validators at period build = the same judge pair (configs/period.json). G2 ignores register and format (owner decision 2026-11-09) and person/tense (2026-11-20).

providers.comment: one provider per judge model, no fallback: the king and every challenger are judged on the same infrastructure; if it is down, evaluations pause (owner's requirement 2026-11-21). Slugs checked live 2026-11-21.

injection_screen.comment: a dedicated judge before G1-G3 (owner's decision 2026-11-21): an output with a verified injected passage is level 0 and never reaches the quality judges

g3.comment: G3 v3 (owner decision 2026-11-20): judges list defects with a quote, kind and severity; a few minor slips -> 0.75, at most max(minor_base, ceil(words / words_per_minor)); any major -> 0.5; broken / incoherent / artifact -> 0
